caption_L1: Age distribution in the United States from 2009 to 2019 is a area graph. 15-64 years is measured along a scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 0.6 along the y-axis. A linear scale from 2010 to 2018 can be found along the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: There is an overall trend of decreasing age distribution over the years between 2009 to 2019. The decrease has been consistent and thus is shown by a straight line graph.
